blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Four young women riding on a single motorcycle were injured after colliding with a taxi at the intersection of Leon Kilat and Sanciangko Streets in Cebu City at 2:16 a.m. on Saturday, Nov. 14, 2026. The motorcycle driver, identified only by the alias Henessy, 28, was rushed to the Cebu City Medical Center. Authorities described her as a resident of Sitio Laguna, Bulacao, Cebu City. Also injured were her three riders: alias Lourdes, 31, of B. Aranas, Duljo Fatima; alias Eljane, 27, of Bulacao; and alias Nice, 28, of Sto. Niño, Kinasang-an Pardo.
